+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from assemblyai import Transcriber, TranscriptionConfig
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        return 1
+    audio_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
+    if not audio_path.exists():
+        return 1
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        return 1
+    os.environ["ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"] = api_key
+    transcriber = Transcriber()
+    config = TranscriptionConfig(speaker_labels=True)
+    transcript = transcriber.transcribe(str(audio_path), config=config)
+    utterances = []
+    for utterance in getattr(transcript, "utterances", []) or []:
+        utterances.append({"speaker": utterance.speaker, "text": utterance.text, "start": utterance.start, "end": utterance.end})
+    print(json.dumps({"text": transcript.text, "utterances": utterances}, ensure_ascii=False))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: poll_transcription.py
+import os
+import time
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+DEEPGRAM_API_BASE = "https://api.deepgram.com"
+
+
+def poll_transcription(job_id: str, timeout: int = 300, interval: int = 5, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    api_key = api_key or os.getenv("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is required")
+
+    deadline = time.time() + timeout
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Token {api_key}"}
+    url = f"{DEEPGRAM_API_BASE}/v1/listen/{job_id}"
+
+    while True:
+        response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        payload: Dict[str, Any] = response.json()
+
+        status = str(payload.get("status", "")).lower()
+        if status in {"completed", "done", "success"}:
+            results = payload.get("results", {})
+            channels = results.get("channels", []) if isinstance(results, dict) else []
+            if channels:
+                alternatives = channels[0].get("alternatives", []) if isinstance(channels[0], dict) else []
+                if alternatives:
+                    transcript = alternatives[0].get("transcript", "")
+                    if transcript:
+                        return transcript
+            if "transcript" in payload:
+                return str(payload["transcript"])
+            raise RuntimeError("Transcription completed but no transcript was found")
+
+        if status in {"failed", "error"}:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Transcription job failed: {payload}")
+
+        if time.time() >= deadline:
+            raise TimeoutError("Timed out waiting for transcription job")
+
+        time.sleep(interval)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: poll_transcription.py JOB_ID")
+
+    print(poll_transcription(sys.argv[1]))
*** End Patch

Task: submits an audio file for batch transcription.

"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: submit_transcription.py
+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+
+
+def submit_transcription(audio_path: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-transcribe") -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as f:
+        audio_bytes = f.read()
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": model,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "type": "input_audio",
+                "input_audio": {
+                    "data": base64.b64encode(audio_bytes).decode("ascii"),
+                    "format": os.path.splitext(audio_path)[1].lstrip(".").lower() or "mp3",
+                },
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
+            return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
+        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenAI API request failed: {e.code} {body}") from e
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Submit an audio file for batch transcription using OpenAI.")
+    parser.add_argument("audio_file")
+    parser.add_argument("--model", default="gpt-4o-transcribe")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    result = submit_transcription(args.audio_file, args.model)
+    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, indent=2)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
